subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw split this umbrella into native tool batching, context block lifecycle, and plan enforcement tracks, and which of those belong in core runtime/API work versus plugin or ClawHub surfaces?
rationale: The request adds native tool schemas, persisted context semantics, new config/settings, and runner enforcement policy; repository policy and VISION.md make those compatibility- and product-sensitive decisions rather than a narrow repair.

options.title: Split Into Design Tracks
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Canonicals
options.body: Use the context-clearing and workflow-mode issues as canonical for their portions and open a smaller batching-only issue if maintainers want that tracked independently.

options.title: Reject Core Orchestration Expansion
options.body: Close or narrow the umbrella if maintainers decide plan enforcement and AI-controlled context block semantics are too much heavy orchestration for core.

recommendation.title: Split Into Design Tracks
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require separate maintainer-reviewed designs for batching, context lifecycle, and plan enforcement before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history across update_plan, tool runtime surfaces, and prior product/API review comments on this issue family.
